verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis for a cloud platform, but the evidence does not show Azure delivering it. Probes returned HTTP 404 for learn.microsoft.com/llms.txt and for the markdown docs variant. The official MCP server evidence belongs to a separate story and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
